CREATE VIEW public.v_data_quality_issues WITH (security_invoker=true) AS  WITH purchase_history_products AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT pi.product_id
           FROM (purchase_items pi
             JOIN purchases p ON ((p.id = pi.purchase_id)))
          WHERE ((p.status <> 'cancelled'::text) AND (pi.product_id IS NOT NULL))
        ), recent_consumed_products AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ml.product_id
           FROM (movements m
             JOIN movement_lines ml ON ((ml.movement_id = m.id)))
          WHERE ((m.type = 'exit'::text) AND (m.status = 'confirmed'::text) AND (m.created_at >= (now() - '90 days'::interval)))
        ), duplicate_names AS (
         SELECT lower(regexp_replace(TRIM(BOTH FROM products.name), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text)) AS norm_name,
            (count(*))::integer AS duplicate_count,
            string_agg((products.name || COALESCE((' · SKU '::text || NULLIF(products.sku, ''::text)), ''::text)), ' / '::text ORDER BY products.name) AS names
           FROM products
          WHERE (products.active = true)
          GROUP BY (lower(regexp_replace(TRIM(BOTH FROM products.name), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text)))
         HAVING (count(*) > 1)
        ), used_suppliers AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT s.id,
            s.name,
            s.tax_id,
            s.phone
           FROM (suppliers s
             JOIN purchases p ON ((p.supplier_id = s.id)))
          WHERE (p.status <> 'cancelled'::text)
        )

CREATE VIEW public.v_stock_by_warehouse WITH (security_invoker=true) AS  SELECT b.warehouse_id,
    w.name AS warehouse_name,
    b.product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    p.base_unit,
    (sum(b.quantity_remaining))::numeric(18,6) AS stock_qty
   FROM ((inventory_batches b
     JOIN warehouses w ON ((w.id = b.warehouse_id)))
     JOIN products p ON ((p.id = b.product_id)))
  WHERE (b.quantity_remaining > (0)::numeric)
  GROUP BY b.warehouse_id, w.name, b.product_id, p.name, p.base_unit;

CREATE VIEW public.v_barge_consumption WITH (security_invoker=true) AS  SELECT m.barge_id,
    b.number AS barge_number,
    ml.product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    (sum(ba.quantity))::numeric(18,6) AS base_quantity,
    ba.currency,
    (sum((ba.quantity * COALESCE(ba.unit_cost, (0)::numeric))))::numeric(18,2) AS real_cost
   FROM ((((movements m
     JOIN movement_lines ml ON ((ml.movement_id = m.id)))
     JOIN products p ON ((p.id = ml.product_id)))
     JOIN barges b ON ((b.id = m.barge_id)))
     LEFT JOIN batch_allocations ba ON ((ba.movement_line_id = ml.id)))
  WHERE ((m.type = 'exit'::text) AND (m.status = 'confirmed'::text) AND (m.barge_id IS NOT NULL))
  GROUP BY m.barge_id, b.number, ml.product_id, p.name, ba.currency;

CREATE VIEW public.v_purchase_alerts WITH (security_invoker=true) AS  SELECT p.id AS purchase_id,
    p.company_id,
    c.name AS company_name,
    p.supplier_id,
    s.name AS supplier_name,
    p.warehouse_id,
    w.name AS warehouse_name,
    p.status,
    p.urgency,
    p.ordered_date,
    p.expected_date,
    p.currency,
    COALESCE(sum((GREATEST((pi.quantity - pi.received_qty), (0)::numeric) * pi.unit_price)), (0)::numeric) AS pending_amount,
    (count(pi.id) FILTER (WHERE (pi.received_qty < pi.quantity)))::integer AS pending_items,
        CASE
            WHEN (p.expected_date IS NULL) THEN 0
            ELSE GREATEST((CURRENT_DATE - p.expected_date), 0)
        END AS days_late,
        CASE
            WHEN (p.urgency = 'critical'::text) THEN 'critical'::text
            WHEN ((p.expected_date < CURRENT_DATE) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM purchase_items x
              WHERE ((x.purchase_id = p.id) AND (x.received_qty < x.quantity))))) THEN 'critical'::text
            WHEN (p.urgency = 'urgent'::text) THEN 'warning'::text
            ELSE 'info'::text
        END AS alert_level
   FROM ((((purchases p
     JOIN purchase_companies c ON ((c.id = p.company_id)))
     LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON ((s.id = p.supplier_id)))
     LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON ((w.id = p.warehouse_id)))
     LEFT JOIN purchase_items pi ON ((pi.purchase_id = p.id)))
  WHERE ((p.destination_type = 'warehouse'::text) AND (p.status = ANY (ARRAY['ordered'::text, 'in_transit'::text, 'partially_received'::text])))
  GROUP BY p.id, c.name, s.name, w.name;

CREATE VIEW public.v_product_360_consumption WITH (security_invoker=true) AS  SELECT ml.product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    p.base_unit,
    (COALESCE(sum(ml.base_quantity) FILTER (WHERE (m.created_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval))), (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,6) AS qty_30d,
    (COALESCE(sum(ml.base_quantity) FILTER (WHERE (m.created_at >= (now() - '60 days'::interval))), (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,6) AS qty_60d,
    (COALESCE(sum(ml.base_quantity) FILTER (WHERE (m.created_at >= (now() - '90 days'::interval))), (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,6) AS qty_90d,
    (count(DISTINCT m.id) FILTER (WHERE (m.created_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval))))::integer AS exits_30d,
    (count(DISTINCT m.id) FILTER (WHERE (m.created_at >= (now() - '60 days'::interval))))::integer AS exits_60d,
    (count(DISTINCT m.id) FILTER (WHERE (m.created_at >= (now() - '90 days'::interval))))::integer AS exits_90d,
    max(m.created_at) AS last_exit_at
   FROM ((movements m
     JOIN movement_lines ml ON ((ml.movement_id = m.id)))
     JOIN products p ON ((p.id = ml.product_id)))
  WHERE ((m.type = 'exit'::text) AND (m.status = 'confirmed'::text))
  GROUP BY ml.product_id, p.name, p.base_unit;

CREATE VIEW public.v_stock_status WITH (security_invoker=true) AS  SELECT sm.warehouse_id,
    w.name AS warehouse_name,
    sm.product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    p.base_unit,
    sm.minimum_qty,
    (COALESCE(sum(ib.quantity_remaining), (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,6) AS stock_qty,
    (COALESCE(sum(ib.quantity_remaining), (0)::numeric) <= sm.minimum_qty) AS is_critical
   FROM (((stock_minimums sm
     JOIN warehouses w ON ((w.id = sm.warehouse_id)))
     JOIN products p ON ((p.id = sm.product_id)))
     LEFT JOIN inventory_batches ib ON (((ib.warehouse_id = sm.warehouse_id) AND (ib.product_id = sm.product_id) AND (ib.quantity_remaining > (0)::numeric))))
  GROUP BY sm.warehouse_id, w.name, sm.product_id, p.name, p.base_unit, sm.minimum_qty;

CREATE VIEW public.bi_purchase_facts WITH (security_invoker=true) AS  WITH item_totals AS (

            COALESCE(sum((pi.received_qty * pi.unit_price)), (0)::numeric) AS received_amount,
            COALESCE(sum((GREATEST((pi.quantity - pi.received_qty), (0)::numeric) * pi.unit_price)), (0)::numeric) AS pending_amount
           FROM purchase_items pi
          GROUP BY pi.purchase_id
        ), receipt_summary AS (
         SELECT pr.purchase_id,
            min(pr.received_at) AS first_received_at,
            max(pr.received_at) AS last_received_at,
            (count(*))::integer AS receipt_count
           FROM purchase_receipts pr
          GROUP BY pr.purchase_id
        )
 SELECT p.id AS purchase_id,
    p.ordered_date,
    (date_trunc('month'::text, (p.ordered_date)::timestamp with time zone))::date AS ordered_month,
    p.company_id,
    c.name AS company_name,
    p.supplier_id,
    s.name AS supplier_name,
    p.warehouse_id,
    w.name AS warehouse_name,
    p.barge_id,
    b.number AS barge_number,

    p.urgency,

    p.expected_date,
    p.delivery_mode,
    p.order_reference,
    p.po_number,
    p.invoice_number,
    p.requester,
    p.sector,
    p.created_at,
    p.updated_at,
    COALESCE(it.item_count, 0) AS item_count,

    COALESCE(it.received_amount, (0)::numeric) AS received_amount,
    COALESCE(it.pending_amount, (0)::numeric) AS pending_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(it.total_amount, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN round(((it.received_amount / it.total_amount) * (100)::numeric), 1)
            ELSE (0)::numeric

            ELSE 0

CREATE VIEW public.v_smart_stock_alerts WITH (security_invoker=true) AS  WITH usage30 AS (

                    WHEN c.policy_active THEN GREATEST(c.raw_recommended_buy_qty, c.min_order_qty)
                    ELSE round(c.raw_recommended_buy_qty, 2)
                END AS recommended_buy_qty

                    WHEN ((r.avg_daily_30d > (0)::numeric) AND (r.coverage_days <= (3)::numeric)) THEN 'critical'::text

                    WHEN ((r.overdue_inbound_qty > (0)::numeric) AND (r.avg_daily_30d > (0)::numeric) AND (r.coverage_days <= (7)::numeric)) THEN 'critical'::text

                    WHEN ((r.avg_daily_30d > (0)::numeric) AND (r.coverage_days <= (7)::numeric)) THEN 'low'::text

                    WHEN (r.recommended_buy_qty > (0)::numeric) THEN 'low'::text

                    WHEN ((r.avg_daily_30d > (0)::numeric) AND (r.coverage_days <= (3)::numeric)) THEN 'Cobertura de 3 días o menos'::text

                    WHEN ((r.overdue_inbound_qty > (0)::numeric) AND (r.avg_daily_30d > (0)::numeric) AND (r.coverage_days <= (7)::numeric)) THEN 'Compra atrasada y cobertura corta'::text

                    WHEN ((r.avg_daily_30d > (0)::numeric) AND (r.coverage_days <= (7)::numeric)) THEN 'Cobertura de 7 días o menos'::text
